documents.title: Setting Up Of A Leaf Spring Manufacturing Facility At The Existing Manufacturing Plant Under M/S. Jai Suspensions Limited, A Wholly Owned Subsidiary Of The Company.
Unaudited Financial Results For Half Year And Quarter Ended September 30, 2026

analysis.summary: Jamna Auto Industries reported consolidated net sales of Rs 786 crore and EBITDA of Rs 108 crore for Q2 FY 2026-27. The company completed its acquisition of Owen Springs Limited on September 1, 2026. First-phase assembly operations for the Trailer Suspension and Axle projects at Indore are ready and awaiting administrative approval. Additionally, the company was awarded the stabilizer bar business by Daimler India Commercial Vehicles. Jamna Auto Industries Limited published its investor presentation for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 (Q1 FY27).

guidance.claim: The capacity relocation creates proactive, demand-led capacity supporting the company's five-year Lakshya growth framework.
guidance.quote: Creates proactive, demand-led capacity in support of the Company’s five-year Lakshya growth framework.

guidance.claim: Jamna Auto Industries targets achieving Rs. 5,000 crores in revenue, 40% revenue share from new markets, 40% ROCE, and a 50% dividend payout by FY 2029-30.
guidance.quote: Target is to achieve Rs. 5,000 crores Revenue, New Markets (Indian After Market + Export) to be 40% of Revenue, deliver 40% ROCE and 50% Dividend payout, by FY 2029-30.

guidance.claim: Jamna Auto Industries is targeting 40% of its turnover from new markets as part of its Lakshya RISE 5000 growth ambition.
guidance.quote: A step toward 40% of turnover from new markets —part of JAI’s Lakshya RISE 5000 growth ambition.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian commercial vehicle industry recorded its strongest-ever second quarter during Q2 FY 2026-27.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian commercial vehicle industry recorded its strongest-ever second quarter during Q2 FY 2026-27.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian commercial vehicle industry showed steady momentum during Q1 FY27 supported by positive underlying economic factors.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian commercial vehicle industry demonstrated steady momentum during Q1, driven by positive underlying economic factors..

demand_outlook.claim: Fundamental demand drivers for the commercial vehicle sector remain positive, supported by sustained infrastructure investments and economic conditions.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, the fundamental demand drivers for the commercial vehicle sector looks Positive supported by sustained infrastructure investments and favorable economic conditions

capex_expansion.claim: First-phase assembly operations for the Trailer Suspension and Axle projects at Indore are ready.
capex_expansion.quote: First-phase which is assembly operations for the Trailer Suspension and Axle projects at Indore are ready.

capex_expansion.claim: A proposed 1,500 MT per month conventional leaf spring line is being relocated from Adityapur to the Malanpur facility.
capex_expansion.quote: This proposed 1,500 MT per month conventional leaf spring line is being relocated from the subsidiary's Adityapur plant to the Company's existing Malanpur facility.

capex_expansion.claim: The acquisition of Owen Springs Limited was completed on September 1, 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: The acquisition of Owen Springs Limited, approved by the Board on 24 July 2026, was completed on 1 September 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved the acquisition of UK-based leaf and parabolic spring manufacturer Owen Springs Limited for £2.00 million.
capex_expansion.quote: On 24 July 2026 Board approved the acquisition of Owen Springs Limited, a leaf and parabolic spring manufacturer at Rotherham in the UK for £ 2.00 million funded entirely from internal accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: Jamna Auto Industries announced the proposed acquisition of Owen Springs Limited, a company incorporated in England and Wales.
capex_expansion.quote: we are enclosing herewith the presentation on proposed acquisition of M/s. Owen Springs Limited, a company incorporated in England and Wales.

capex_expansion.claim: The acquisition of Owen Springs represents JAI's first-ever acquisition.
The acquisition provides JAI with a wholly-owned platform in the UK leaf and parabolic spring aftermarket.
capex_expansion.quote: A wholly-owned platform in the leaf & parabolic spring UK aftermarket.

margins_costs.claim: Commercial settlements with customers regarding first-quarter steel and energy cost increases have been completed.
margins_costs.quote: Commercial settlement with our customers in respect of the steel and energy cost increases reported in the first quarter has been Completed..

margins_costs.claim: Input costs increased significantly due to higher crude oil and energy prices caused by the West Asia conflict.
margins_costs.quote: The conflict in West Asia has raised crude oil and energy prices, which has impacted the Cost Significantly.

margins_costs.claim: Commercial settlements with customers to pass on increased costs are progressing constructively.
margins_costs.quote: Commercial Settlement with Customers are progressing constructively for passing on the increased in Cost.

margins_costs.claim: Management charges paid to the erstwhile parent of Owen Springs will not be payable post-acquisition.
margins_costs.quote: * Management charges to erstwhile parent, not payable post-acquisition.

margins_costs.claim: The acquisition platform is described as margin-accretive, cash-funded, and scalable.

orders_capacity.claim: Jamna Auto was awarded the stabilizer bar business by Daimler India Commercial Vehicles.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company has been awarded the stabilizer bar business by Daimler India Commercial Vehicles..

orders_capacity.claim: The relocated conventional leaf spring line capacity remains unchanged at 1,500 MT per month.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity unchanged at 1,500 MT per month —a change of site, not an additional line

orders_capacity.claim: Owen Springs maintains a product range of over 350 SKUs serving around 250 distributors, retailers, and garages.
orders_capacity.quote: 350+ SKU’s spanning commercial vehicles (LCV and HGV), heritage rail locomotives, agricultural and classic vehicles — serving around 250 distributors, retailers and garages.

capital_allocation.quote: On 24 July 2026 Board approved the acquisition of Owen Springs Limited, a leaf and parabolic spring manufacturer at Rotherham in the UK for £ 2.00 million funded entirely from internal accruals.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has set a target dividend payout ratio of 50% under its RISE 5000 strategic plan.
capital_allocation.quote: Target is to achieve Rs. 5,000 crores Revenue, New Markets (Indian After Market + Export) to be 40% of Revenue, deliver 40% ROCE and 50% Dividend payout, by FY 2029-30.

capital_allocation.claim: The acquisition will result in 100% ownership and will be funded entirely from internal accruals with no external debt or shareholder dilution.
capital_allocation.quote: 100% ownership, funded entirely from JAI’s internal accruals —no external debt, no shareholder dilution.

risks_headwinds.claim: Conflict in West Asia has led to elevated crude oil and energy prices, impacting operating costs significantly.
risks_headwinds.quote: The conflict in West Asia has raised crude oil and energy prices, which has impacted the Cost Significantly.

management_commitments.quote: Target is to achieve Rs. 5,000 crores Revenue, New Markets (Indian After Market + Export) to be 40% of Revenue, deliver 40% ROCE and 50% Dividend payout, by FY 2029-30.

management_commitments.claim: Jamna Auto Industries is targeting 40% of its turnover from new markets as part of its Lakshya RISE 5000 ambition.
management_commitments.quote: A step toward 40% of turnover from new markets —part of JAI’s Lakshya RISE 5000 growth ambition.
